Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
On-site 5/5 – Bucharest, AFI Park Mall 
 Full-time | Level: Senior (+5 years experience) 
 Do you have strong experience developing modern web applications with React and TypeScript, together with excellent communication skills, a problem solving mindset, and the ability to work effectively in a technical team?
 Are you comfortable taking ownership of frontend architecture, working closely with backend developers and product stakeholders, and contributing to complex software products?
 Are you ambitious and would relish the opportunity grow your career in a Romanian software company? If the answer is ‘yes’ to these questions then we would love to hear from you.
 What you’ll be working on 
 The Senior React Developer will be part of a development team responsible for designing, implementing, testing, and documenting frontend functionality for BC2A Software Suite applications, in line with internal engineering and quality procedures.
 The role will include:
 · Design and implementation of modern web user interfaces using React and TypeScript
 · Definition and evolution of frontend architecture, application structure, reusable components, and development standards
 · Integration with backend services using REST APIs and real time communication mechanisms
 · Collaboration with backend developers, architects, Product Owners, and other engineering teams
 · Analysis of project and product requirements and translation of these requirements into maintainable frontend solutions
 · Development of complex data driven user interfaces for Command and Control applications
 · Implementation of maps, tactical visualisation, dashboards, forms, and other interactive components
 · Performance optimisation for applications handling large amounts of frequently changing data
 · Maintenance and improvement of existing frontend applications
 · Technical documentation of architecture, components, interfaces, and important implementation decisions
 · Code reviews and technical guidance for other frontend developers
 · Participation in technical discussions regarding product architecture and technology choices
 · Validation and testing of successive software versions as part of the complete system
 · Collaboration with Product Owners to ensure that implemented functionality meets operational and product requirements
 Who we’re looking for 
 Skills and abilities we are looking for in Senior React Developer candidates include:
 · Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or similar technical field
 · Minimum 5 years of professional software development experience
 · Strong professional experience with React
 · Strong knowledge of TypeScript and JavaScript
 · Strong understanding of modern frontend architecture and component based application design
 · Strong knowledge of HTML and CSS
 · Experience with modern React development patterns
 · Experience with application state management
 · Experience integrating frontend applications with REST APIs
 · Experience working with asynchronous data and real time updates
 · Good understanding of HTTP, JSON, WebSockets, and browser networking concepts
 · Good understanding of software engineering principles, including SOLID principles, separation of concerns, maintainability, and testability
 · Ability to analyse technical requirements and standards and translate them into software solutions
 · Ability to understand and work within an existing software architecture
 · Strong debugging and problem solving skills
 · Good written and verbal communication skills
 · Capability to analyze technical standards in order to be able to design and implement solutions which are compliant with these standards
 Nice to have 
 · Geospatial applications and interactive maps
 · OpenLayers, or similar mapping libraries
 · Command and Control or situational awareness systems
 · WebSocket, SignalR, or event driven user interfaces
 · Large scale data visualisation
 · Material UI or similar component libraries
 · OpenAPI based client generation
 · Docker and containerised development environments
 · Authentication and authorization using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, or Keycloak
 · Experience working with .NET backend systems
 Responsibilities: 
 · Implements new frontend functionalities on existing products;
 · Participate on designing of new products architecture;
 · Participate on implementation of a new generation of BC2A suite based on new cloud technologies;
 · Work closely with backend developers to define clear and effective interfaces between frontend and backend components
 · Support the implementation of the next generation of the BC2A Software Suite using modern web and cloud technologies
 · Unit testing;
 What We Offer 
 · Highly complex technical projects in the field of Defense and National Security, with real impact, involving critical Command & Control systems;
 · Stable company with long-term projects;
 · Private medical services subscription;
 · Additional vacation days;
 · Meal vouchers.
 What you’ll be joining 
 You will be joining an organization that is a private software company, provider of Command and Control systems for the Defense and Homeland Security Market and software solutions integrator. With an experience in C2 systems of over 16 years, ISW delivered own solutions to Defense (Land Forces) and Homeland Security entities in Romania. Please view the 'about' page for more information about the company (https://intersystems.ro/isw).
